exposure: Women with a partner who was Black
cohort: 2,138 women who completed all sections of an online survey about their experiences of maternity care in the United States
finding: Mistreatment during childbirth is more common among women of color, those who give birth in hospitals, and those with social, economic, or health challenges.
mod_finding: Having a vaginal birth was associated with a lower likelihood of mistreatment.
